notes.title: My New Game “Monster Mayhem” Launches June 27!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]

I’m super excited to announce that my next game, Monster Mayhem, will be launching on June 27 on Steam!

I’ve been working solo on this project for a while now, and if you’ve enjoyed any of my previous games, I think you’ll really enjoy this one too. Monster Mayhem is a fast-paced 2D survivors like game where you fight through waves of monsters, unlock unique heroes, and take down huge bosses – all wrapped in a colorful, cartoonish style.

If you’d like to support a solo dev, the best way is to wishlist the game, it helps a lot with visibility on launch day:
---> https://store.steampowered.com/app/3585220/Monster_Mayhem/

Thanks so much for all the support, it means the world to me. See you June 27!
